gloss_en: Which Chinese encoding should I use when generating IFC? UTF-8 still gives messy code.
title_original: Chinese encode in IFC
question_paraphrase: which chinese encoding pattern do you use in IFC generation? tried utf-8 but still messy code
phrasing_notes: non-native English, very short, no code or file, polite closer
answer_summary: IFC/STEP escapes Unicode with \X2\hex\X0\; IfcOpenShell supports it; UTF-8 XML output via IfcConvert works.

gloss_en: Strings mixing Latin with Cyrillic or Chinese get truncated when reading ifcXML in Python.
title_original: Wrong string value parsed from the file
question_paraphrase: attribute strings containing latin plus cyrillic/chinese are truncated, the non-latin char acts like start of string
context_given: small ifcxml test file, by_type('IfcWindow') loop
phrasing_notes: code block plus minimal repro, factual
answer_summary: Truncation was in the old ifcXML parser, which is now disabled; will be reimplemented.

gloss_en: Parametric dimension fields should accept comma as decimal separator so the numpad works.
title_original: Decimal , and . for parametric elements
question_paraphrase: living in europe my keyboard uses , as decimal separator; many software accept both; want numpad use
answer_summary: Implemented: metric grammar accepts comma and normalises internally.

gloss_en: Umlauts (Ae Ue Oe ss) show wrongly in dynamically generated Blender enums.
title_original: Umlauts in dynamic enumerations
question_paraphrase: umlauts in dynamically generated enums are not represented correctly
phrasing_notes: terse, links to Blender StackExchange workaround
answer_summary: Known Blender dynamic EnumProperty bug; fixed with workaround in the add-on.

gloss_en: IfcConvert XML output contains a control character from a \X\1F escape, so Expat rejects it as not well-formed.
title_original: Non-well-formed XML generated if IFC contains specific Unicode characters
question_paraphrase: third-party IFC has 'Arial\X\1F_Transparent_red'; XML output not well-formed, expat invalid token
context_given: IfcOpenShell 0.6/0.7, line sample, tried XML 1.1 header
phrasing_notes: detailed, quotes raw file line and XML output
answer_summary: Control chars are illegal in XML 1.0; serializer should escape or drop them.

gloss_en: web-ifc GetLine decodes Chinese wrongly when the \X2\ hex is lowercase.
title_original: The GetLine() API method has an error in parsing Chinese
question_paraphrase: '\X2\7d20586b571f\X0\' decodes wrong; uppercase hex decodes right
answer_summary: Hex digits a-f were not accepted by getNextHex(); add lowercase handling.

gloss_en: Mac-made ArchiCAD files use Mac OS Roman bytes in \X\ escapes so French accents decode wrong.
title_original: String Encoding Problem (Mac OS Roman encoding)
question_paraphrase: 'Cote oppose' encoded as C\X\99t\X\8E; decoded as replacement chars; Latin-1 80-9F are control chars so assume MacRoman
phrasing_notes: precise, cites Wikipedia, gives example string
answer_summary: Fixed in web-ifc by handling MacRoman range.

gloss_en: When writing a name like batiment with a circumflex, the next character disappears in the written IFC.
title_original: Encoding of special characters eats the following character
question_paraphrase: pass 'batiment' as building name, a gets encoded but the t after it disappears
answer_summary: Writer bug in \X2\ terminator handling; fixed.

gloss_en: One invalid escape (\X\C3\X96 for Oe) breaks decoding of all later strings in the file.
title_original: Malformed encoding in IFC file causes global decoding failure
question_paraphrase: incorrectly escaped sequence breaks decoding of entire file, subsequent correct strings fail too
phrasing_notes: structured with Problem and Expected Behavior sections
answer_summary: Invalid per ISO 10303-21; parser should fail only that string; fix merged.

gloss_en: In German Revit the import class mapping file shows umlauts wrong and is re-saved as ANSI, causing import errors.
title_original: Character encoding issues with import class mappings in German locale
question_paraphrase: umlauts wrong with UTF8 mapping file; UI saves as ANSI; ANSI file with corrected umlauts causes import errors
context_given: German Revit UI, Open > IFC Options
answer_summary: Add explicit encoding to StreamReader; later fixed; better to key on BuiltInCategory.

gloss_en: Multiline text parameter filled in Revit does not appear in the IFC4 export when viewed in Solibri.
title_original: INQ: Multiline text parameter in Revit not showing on IFC 4
question_paraphrase: multiline text parameter with values not showing on IFC4 exported from Revit
answer_summary: Maintainers asked for parameter name; question is property-set mapping of a non-standard parameter (tangential to encoding, newline text).

gloss_en: IFC with wall name '\S\ciana 1' shows no geometry in Xbim Xplorer though BimVision displays it.
title_original: Special unicode characters used in Name of IFCWALL cause no geometry
question_paraphrase: no geometry in XBimXplorer; name has '\S\ciana 1'; stripping \S\ fixes it
phrasing_notes: describes workaround and cross-checks other viewer
answer_summary: Form-feed char and invalid IfcRelVoidsElement param broke file; parser to be made resilient.

gloss_en: Is there an Xbim class to encode words into IFC string encoding when writing?
title_original: Encoding string
question_paraphrase: XbimP21StringDecoder decodes; is there an existing class to encode when writing
answer_summary: Toolkit encodes/decodes automatically; use plain Unicode C# strings.

gloss_en: IfcBeam with Czech name using \S\ escapes and raw characters parses as an empty instance.
title_original: String decoding
question_paraphrase: beam '\S\Z\S\^^l. n\S\ametk. krokev' parsed empty, all attributes null
answer_summary: File mixes raw non-ASCII with escapes, illegal IFC; user asks parser to skip bad chars like other readers.

gloss_en: File with Japanese \X2\ text and a doubled backslash loads only 10 of 78 products.
title_original: IFC file fails to load due to invalid string
question_paraphrase: fails to load, many entities missing due to ...\\X2\... line; works with one backslash removed
context_given: Xbim develop branch, MSTest snippet, confidential file
phrasing_notes: clear, offers test code; content is Japanese, post is English
answer_summary: Double backslash is an encoded backslash so text is invalid; parser now degrades gracefully with null value.

gloss_en: IFC header FILE_NAME with Windows path containing single backslashes fails to load in new Xplorer.
title_original: IFC file with single backslash in STRING (HEADER:FILENAME) fails to load
question_paraphrase: FILE_NAME('C:\Users\1PIPEIFC.IFC') not properly encoded; latest Xplorer cannot open
answer_summary: Backslash must be doubled per Part 21; request for lenient reading.

gloss_en: SolidWorks IFC has Cyrillic names written raw alongside \X2\ pieces, Python read fails.
title_original: Swood Design (SolidWorks) - IFC read error
question_paraphrase: IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY name mixes \X2\ escapes with raw Cyrillic; Python exception on read
phrasing_notes: English post by Russian-speaking user, pastes file and traceback
answer_summary: Raw Cyrillic is invalid IFC; exporter must escape all non-ASCII; maintainer explains strictness.

gloss_en: IfcConvert to XML fails with wstring_convert error when the header FILE_NAME has accented chars.
title_original: [IfcConvert] Convert string error
question_paraphrase: IFC with special characters in header FILE_NAME gives wstring_convert: to_bytes error; DAE works
context_given: zip attached, cites buildingSMART string encoding guidance
phrasing_notes: French-speaking writer in English, cites guidance page
answer_summary: Raw non-ASCII violates the Part 21 version used; make conversion lenient and warn.

gloss_en: Brazilian user cannot open an ArchiStation IFC in Bonsai on Ubuntu; file has raw 0xE7/0xE3 bytes.
title_original: Falha de importação de arquivo IFC com Bonsai
question_paraphrase: IFC from Archstation does not open in Bonsai on Ubuntu 24.04, even after downgrading Blender
context_given: Ubuntu 24.04, no access to source software
phrasing_notes: numbered steps in Portuguese, error log
answer_summary: Analysis: raw Latin-1 bytes instead of \X\ escapes; needs policy decision on lenient decoding.

gloss_en: OBJ conversion fails on a surface style name with Turkish dotted I and C-cedilla encoded via \X2\.
title_original: Unicode characters in IFC file made OBJ conversion fail.
question_paraphrase: IFCSURFACESTYLE('\X2\00C70130\X0\ZG...') fails OBJ conversion; used to work
answer_summary: Same fix as XML: write converted names in escaped form.

gloss_en: After export from web-ifc, Czech diacritics are broken and other viewers choke.
title_original: Encoding breaks when exporting the model
question_paraphrase: algorithm changes \X2 to \X and 00E9 to E9; breaks model for other viewers
answer_summary: Writer produced malformed escapes; fixed in later version.

gloss_en: Danish letters in property values show as \X\E6; request UTF-8 style handling.
title_original: UTF-8 encoding
question_paraphrase: I use UTF-8 because of AE O AA; values read like V\X\E6gelement; probably other languages too
answer_summary: \X\E6 is the ISO 8859-1 escape for ae; library should decode on read.

gloss_en: IfcText values with special characters get cut off since web-ifc 0.0.43; ArchiCAD and SimpleBIM encode differently.
title_original: GetLine() outputs incomplete IfcText values
question_paraphrase: strings with special characters cut off; different flavours of encoding between ArchiCAD and SimpleBIM
context_given: two minimal test files, regression after update
answer_summary: Fixed in 0.0.45.

gloss_en: After updating the IFC exporter, accents are written as \X\E9 instead of \X2\00E9\X0\; was the encoding changed?
title_original: New codification for special character and accent?
question_paraphrase: Revit native wrote Chauss\X2\00E9\X0\, add-in 22.4.1 writes \X\E9; has there been a change?
answer_summary: Toolkit changed (ODA uses compact representation); both are valid.

gloss_en: Taiwanese user's Revit 2022 IFC: lat/long in DMS inside IfcPostalAddress; Chinese address appears as \X2\ hex.
title_original: INQ: Why revit 2023 ifc can export whole longitude and latitude in IFCPOSTALADDRESS but revit 2022 can not
question_paraphrase: degrees minutes seconds cannot turn into correct decimal lat/long; 2023 exports what user enters
context_given: Revit 2022 vs 2023, raw IFC lines with Chinese address escaped
answer_summary: Lat/long belongs in IfcSite, IfcPostalAddress is the envelope address; Chinese text properly escaped.

gloss_en: IfcConvert stops on IFCTEXT('\X2\00D8\X\0A\X0\800') because a \X\ sequence is nested inside \X2\.
title_original: IFCConvert: Symbol error
question_paraphrase: Unexpected 'A' at 25053. Parsing terminated; removing \X\0A makes it work
answer_summary: Syntax invalid per EXPRESS grammar; later versions parse the file.

gloss_en: IfcConvert throws COLLADASW exception when the file name has Chinese or Cyrillic characters.
title_original: Encoding issues in file name
question_paraphrase: special characters in names like Chinese or Cyril occurs StreamWriterException; should we avoid them?
answer_summary: Later traced to a Docker mounting issue, not IFC encoding.

gloss_en: The Euro sign decoded from \X2\ crashes wofstream/wcout; can the conversion be disabled?
title_original: turn off unicode conversion IFCOpenshell Parse
question_paraphrase: euro symbol makes wofstream and wcout crash; need raw string
answer_summary: Windows wcout needs UTF-16; or set IfcCharacterDecoder mode to JSON.

gloss_en: Browse External Style fails when the external material name is Japanese.
title_original: Error when style references to an external material
question_paraphrase: cannot use external style if the material name consists of Japanese characters
answer_summary: Blender dynamic Enum limitation with non-Latin text.

gloss_en: FreeCAD STEP export writes raw Korean/Japanese/Chinese characters instead of \X2\ escapes so commercial CAD cannot open it.
title_original: Export: STEP AP214 exports raw non-ASCII characters instead of escaped Unicode
question_paraphrase: several third-party commercial 3D CAD apps fail to open or display the characters
answer_summary: Spec requires \X2\..\X0\; also a regression of AP selection dialog in non-English UI.

gloss_en: Latest Xplorer fails to load geometry if a property string contains a newline.
title_original: The latest version of XbimXplorer fails to load geometry if the property string contains a newline character
question_paraphrase: property string with newline stops geometry loading
answer_summary: Closed April 2026.

gloss_en: Names of types in the IFC show as garbage, find which ones.
prompt: в ифс названия типов как кракозябры, найди все где имя битое и скажи из какой категории
expected_behavior: Scan Name/ObjectType/property strings for mojibake patterns (replacement chars, Ã, Ð sequences), list entities with class and Revit category, suggest cause.

gloss_en: Check whether Chinese names in the model are escaped properly.
prompt: 这个ifc里中文名称是不是乱码了？帮我查一下墙和房间的名字，导出的时候哪里出问题
expected_behavior: Decode names of IfcWall/IfcSpace, report entries with raw non-ASCII or broken \X2\ sequences, explain Revit export settings.

gloss_en: Property values in Japanese appear garbled in a viewer; verify the file.
prompt: IFCを別のビューアで開くとプロパティの日本語が文字化けしてる。ファイル側の問題か確認して
expected_behavior: Read raw STEP text, verify \X2\ UTF-16 escapes decode to Japanese, determine whether the defect is in the file or the viewer.

gloss_en: List all elements whose names contain Turkish letters and check they read correctly.
prompt: modeldeki isimlerde ş ğ ı İ gibi türkçe karakter geçen elemanları listele, doğru okunuyor mu bak
expected_behavior: Find names with Turkish characters, show decoded and raw escaped forms, flag mismatches (dotted I).

gloss_en: Arabic room names appear as question marks after IFC export.
prompt: أسماء الغرف بالعربي تظهر علامات استفهام بعد تصدير IFC، شو المشكلة؟
expected_behavior: Explain IFC \X2\ escapes, check how strings are stored in the file, viewer font and RTL display issues.

gloss_en: Show space names in Greek; are they correct or strange characters?
prompt: δείξε μου τα ονόματα των χώρων στα ελληνικά, βγαίνουν σωστά ή με περίεργους χαρακτήρες;
expected_behavior: Read IfcSpace Name/LongName, decode, report any broken sequences.

gloss_en: Check whether Korean parameter names and values survived export.
prompt: 한글 매개변수 이름이랑 값이 IFC에 제대로 들어갔는지 확인해줘요. 깨진 거 있으면 알려주세요
expected_behavior: Inspect property sets and values for Korean text, report broken ones with entity ids.

gloss_en: Find strings with raw non-ASCII bytes or malformed escapes.
prompt: scan the file for strings with raw non-ascii bytes or malformed \X\ \X2\ escapes, list line numbers
expected_behavior: Scan raw STEP text for non-ASCII bytes and malformed escapes; report line, entity id, attribute.

gloss_en: Rewrite file so non-ASCII strings are properly escaped.
prompt: fix the file so all non-latin names get proper \X2\ escaping, save as new file, keep guids
expected_behavior: Re-serialise with correct escaping, preserve GlobalIds, report count of changed strings.

gloss_en: Do umlauts and comma decimals in the Psets read correctly?
prompt: stimmen Umlaute und Dezimalkommas in den Psets, oder sind da \X\ Reste und Texte statt Zahlen
expected_behavior: Check pset string values for escape remnants and numbers stored as text with comma decimals; list offenders.

gloss_en: How to avoid Cyrillic problems when exporting from Revit to IFC.
prompt: при экспорте из ревит в ифс русские названия семейств ломаются в другом софте, какие настройки смотреть?
expected_behavior: Explain \X2\ escaping, exporter version differences (\X\ vs \X2\), strictness of the receiving software, test steps.

gloss_en: Python reads Chinese strings from IFC as hex escapes; how to decode?
prompt: ifcopenshell读出来的中文是\X2\开头的，怎么转成正常汉字
expected_behavior: Explain that ifcopenshell decodes automatically; if raw escapes are seen, inspect the file, show snippet.

gloss_en: Compare two exports to see which Japanese names changed.
prompt: 前回のIFCと今回のIFCで、日本語の名称が変わってるものだけ差分出して
expected_behavior: Compare Names between files by GlobalId, list differences, separating encoding-only differences.

gloss_en: Find text properties with comma decimals instead of real numbers.
prompt: some lengths come as text like '2,5' not numbers. list them and tell me if the exporter is set to a european locale
expected_behavior: Find IfcText/IfcLabel properties with numeric-looking comma values, count, suggest converting to IfcReal.

gloss_en: Why do IFC files encode Turkish letters as \X2\ codes?
prompt: ifc dosyasında ğ ü ş harfleri neden \X2\ diye kodlanıyor? bozuk mu?
expected_behavior: Explain STEP Part 21 ASCII-only requirement and \X2\ UTF-16 hex escapes; not corruption.

gloss_en: Fix names that were decoded with the wrong code page.
prompt: в модели имена вида РЎС‚РѕР№ка - вылечи, перекодируй обратно
expected_behavior: Detect cp1251/UTF-8 double-decoding, convert back, write fixed names, report before/after.
